metrics.type_definition: Ordered, consistent actual row passage relations; not guide IDs or homotopy equivalence
metrics.reference_policy: Coverage of known positive types only; unobserved types are not negatives
metrics.unknown_type_policy: Valid unknown routes count in TipValid, not in distinct classified types
metrics.validity_scope: Correct target within3cm, start within5mm, unchanged reach events, physical-box tip segments with2cm clearance; no arm/IK/execution certificate

grid.geometric_guarantee: continuous segment supercover is relative to this discrete proxy only, not true obstacles or full robot; cell-center depth projection and point quantization are approximations
